## Salvage note (2026-10-20T23:26Z, second worker)

The first worker (same harness stamp; `Started:` above) was killed mid-run by an
operator interrupt after Phase ~2. Inherited state: zero commits past the base;
uncommitted `emit_ts.rs` (~714 lines), `clients/ts/{hh-embed.ts,smoke.ts,
fixture-definition.json}`, `scripts/e3-smoke.sh`, the `main.rs`/`check-drift.sh`
diffs, a post-close ci-boundary re-read of #149, and this draft ledger through the
test matrix. **Audit before trust:** the artifact was deleted and regenerated via
`cargo run -p hh-codegen` (byte-identical — genuinely emitted); the emitter compiles
and covers the full op surface (251/251 implemented `call` ops, verified against the
schema). **One real defect found by executing the leg** (the ticket's own point —
emit-and-execute): the emitted transport used `fetch`, and node's undici
unconditionally appends `Sec-Fetch-Mode`, which binding (c)'s P3/P4 gate refuses
(`http 403` on `hello`, observed). Fixed in `emit_ts.rs` — the transport now speaks
`node:http` (stdlib, still zero npm dependencies, one `Connection: close` request per
call — the same dumb-transport shape as the Rust `NetClient`'s raw `TcpStream`);
recorded in the ADR-0050 row's transport note. Everything below from `## Gap table`
on is the second worker's verified account; the dead worker's claims above the plan
were re-verified, not inherited as verification.

## Plan

  schema-driven semantics: `interface`/`type` + `*ToJson`/`*FromJson`
  per type, `EmbedError`/`ClientError`, `NetClient` over `fetch`
  (binding (c): `POST /hh-embed/1`, `GET /hh-embed/1/events` NDJSON),
  typed method per implemented `call` op, `(contract_major,
  schema_hash)` assert at `hello` (ADR-0178 D2). Erasable-syntax-only TS
  (node ≥22 type stripping).

  gains it.

- `crates/hh-codegen/tests/r4_2.rs` — node-presence gate + script run.
- Records: ADR-0050 amendment section, DF-S4.10-1 DONE cell, row-061
  dated note.
